Confirmed in the text: Lilly took out a warrant, kept it private until Sunday 18th, searched only that one house, and 'found part of my fish in water, part eaten, part not consumed; all confessed' — including seven Portugal onions the thief's wife had unknowingly made into pottage.
嗣後施濟貧寒﹐全人夫婦﹐修橋砌路﹐施藥施棺﹐連生二子﹐臨終囑其子曰﹕我非陰功﹐不能有爾﹐爾皆成人﹐多宜積德。
果后三日自刘家集寻得。
特朗普以明确优势胜出
果己巳日全愈
果寅日到平子门外，雪中遇雪贼，劫银四十两。
